This is the landing page of **{{{title}}}**.

Replace this text with an abstract, a summary of the work, or a short guide to
the chapters that follow. Use the sidebar to navigate.

## Reproducibility {.unnumbered}

This publication is rendered with [bookdown](https://bookdown.org){{#renv}} and its R
dependencies are pinned in `renv.lock`{{/renv}}. To rebuild it locally:

```r
bookdown::render_book("index.Rmd")
```

The rendered site is written to `_site/` and published to GitHub Pages by the
workflow in `.github/workflows/publish.yml`.

Chapters are the numbered `.Rmd` files beside this one, in the order listed in
`_bookdown.yml`. Everything the render needs but nobody edits day to day --
shared setup, styling, the bibliography, generated figures -- lives in
`alberdilabr/`.
